content: Handling of the Sign In consequence of [TPS_GST_00008], implementations of a formula processor need to provide an extra handling of the sign in case of integer values. -2147483648 < value < 0 => signed INT (sign "-") -2147483648 < value < 2147483647 => signed INT (sign "-" or "+") -0 => signed INT (sign "-") +0 => signed INT (sign "+") 0 < value < 2147483647 => unsigned INT 2147483647 < value < 4294967295 => unsigned INT.
